whenToUse: A data, analytics or BI product that sells through an interactive query demo.
Technical B2B SaaS with seat × usage pricing and a connectors catalogue.
avoidWhen: General-purpose SaaS with a lighter marketing tone — use site-saas-01.
Developer tools selling an SDK or CLI — use site-devtool-01.
a11y: Chart figures and the estimator total update in aria-live regions; toggles expose aria-pressed.
Provide the chart's key numbers as text so the demo is understandable without the visual.
